notes.content:
Hotfix notes:
[list]

notes.title: EPISODE 2 IS OUT!
notes.content:
That's it, it's out, you can play it.

This episode features more interaction with the characters than the first one, as well as new animations and music.

Everyone was asking, we had this one guy that every day would knock on the office window and ask "When is episode 2 coming out?" So here it is, it's out! We can remove the window now!

If you have already bought convento but haven't played yet, this is a good opportunity to do it and tell us what you liked about it! Or else we might release Convento Remastered GOTY edition without you having played the original! 


FAQ.
[list]
[*] What is it?
It's more game, a continuation of the first episode
[*]Can I eat it?
No, it's just more game, there's no food.
[*]Does it contain new missions and raids with monsters to kill?
No, it's still a visual novel, not a shooter or an action game.
[*]I'm rich, very rich, and I noticed convento is still priced fairly low, will the price go up as more episodes are released?
This is not financial advice, but we are considering changing the price when the full game releases, consider this a reward for believing in us so that one day you will proudly tell your friends "I played Convento when it was Hot, now it's dead, it's literally over"
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.content:
[h2]Convento is now available in Early Access![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863154/3917e4e6e3bd306f81695bf8b58f2010bb6bef53.png[/img]

[h3]Dive in and get to know the characters and the story. But I'm not done yet, all future episodes will be released for free! And wait, there's more. Hold on, actually no, that's it for now.

Please use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2816590/discussions/1/]Bugs, Issues and Support Board[/url] to report any problems you may find.


Future episodes will be announced and released as soon as possible.

Hope you'll enjoy Convento![/h3]
